title: Money Arcade
unlocks: savings-vault decorations and bonus challenge progress

games.name: Coin Stack
games.how: Tap to drop each coin on the tower. Line them up to keep the stack wide.
games.teaches: Small, steady deposits build the tallest stacks. Savings work the same way.

games.name: Cash Catcher
games.how: Slide the purse to catch coins and notes. Dodge the bills and impulse buys.
games.teaches: Little leaks (impulse buys, avoidable interest) quietly drain your money.

games.name: Money Maths
games.how: Quick everyday money sums. Pick the right answer before time runs out.
games.teaches: Fast mental maths for discounts, splits and savings.

games.name: Guess the Currency
games.how: Match each country to its currency and symbol.
games.teaches: Spotting currencies helps when travelling and shopping online from abroad.

games.name: Budget Builder
games.how: Sort each cost into Needs, Wants or Savings.
games.teaches: The 50/30/20 idea: roughly half on needs, a third on wants, a fifth saved.

games.name: Guess the Total
games.how: How much does it add up to? Get as close as you can.
games.teaches: Feel how small, regular amounts grow over time.

games.name: Payday Sprint
games.how: Put the payday steps in the smartest order.
games.teaches: Pay yourself first: bills and savings before spending, not after.

games.name: Money Word
games.how: Guess the five-letter money word in six tries. Green is right, amber is in the word.
games.teaches: Money vocabulary, one word at a time.
